notes.subject: לבן אדמדם
notes.rationale: tupela kala i put tupela tok wantaim — waitpela-redpela; reduplikesen bilong אדמדם i soim kala liklik, i lus long Tok Pisin

notes.subject: פרחת
notes.rationale: piel bilong פרח long hap tsaraat — piksa bilong plawa bilong diwai i sprout

translation: Na sapos long ples bilong hed bihain we i no gat gras, o long fron bilong hed we i no gat gras, i gat sik nogut we i waitpela na redpela liklik, em i tsaraat i sprout i kamap long ples bilong hed bihain bilong em o long fron bilong hed bilong em.

tokens.gloss: long ples bilong hed bihain we i no gat gras
long fron bilong hed we i no gat gras
long ples bilong hed bihain bilong em
long fron bilong hed bilong em
